entries.name: ext-depth-coll10-accept#0
entries.description: Spending-proof extension {1: Coll^10[Byte]}, each outer collection holding one element and the innermost Coll[Byte] empty. Coll[Coll[Byte]] is embeddable (code 0x1a, no recursion in TypeSerializer), so Coll^10 recurses 8 times through the generic-Coll path (0x0c): depth 8 = MaxTypeDepth (TypeSerializer.scala:134-136, SigmaConstants.MaxTypeDepth = 8). Round-trip identity.

entries.name: ext-depth-coll11-reject#1
entries.description: Spending-proof extension {1: Coll^11[Byte]}: one recursion deeper, type depth 9 > 8, and the JVM throws DeserializeCallDepthExceeded at type parse. An impl with a higher type depth limit, or none, round-trips it: the over-accept.
